headline: Approved a package store malt and wine license for 237 Cambridge Street, a restaurant all-alcohol license for 548 Main Street, and several one-day event licenses.
summary: Approved one-day liquor and entertainment licenses for several events, common victualer licenses for new restaurants, and a lodging house license. Postponed a number of items to September 24, 2026, continued one item to the first meeting in December, and filed two items.
decisions: Approved one-day liquor and one-day entertainment licenses for Our Lady of Mercy Maronite Catholic Church, 341 June Street (3-0).
Approved one-day liquor and one-day entertainment licenses for Canal Diggers, Inc., 19 Temple Street (3-0).
Approved one-day liquor license for Worcester Public Library Foundation, 3 Salem Square (3-0).
Approved one-day liquor and one-day entertainment licenses for Marc Guinette, 236 Franklin Street (vote count not given).

Approved one-day entertainment license for Woo Fest Block Party, City View Worcester (3-0).
Approved one-day liquor licenses for Christpher Besaw, 30 Exchange Street, for five dates from September 12 to October 31, 2026 (3-0).

Approved common victualer license for Tropical Chicken Flavors, 229 Canterbury Street (3-0).
Approved change of manager for Falguni Corp, 108 Canterbury Street (3-0).
Approved change of manager for Nachos Dining, Inc. dba Mexicali Cantina & Grill, 225 Shrewsbury Street (3-0).
Postponed OM Harsh Corp dba A&B Liquors, 110 McKeon Road, change of officers/directors request, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).

Approved change of manager for Dubai Restaurant & Lounge, Inc. dba Mexi Town Bar & Grill, 105 Water Street (3-0). The minutes record no vote on the requested dba change to Casa Blanca Restaurant and Lounge.
Postponed Interstate Management Company, LLC (dba Hampton Inn & Suites), 65 Prescott Street, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Approved restaurant all alcohol license for Moss Ventures, LLC dba August Coffee, 548 Main Street (3-0).
Postponed Metro Convenience Inc. 27 Shrewsbury Street package store malt & wine license request to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Approved package store malt & wine license for 237 Cambridge LLC dba Shell, 237 Cambridge Street (3-0).
Approved change of officers/directors and change of manager for Punta Cana Bar & Grill Restaurant, Inc., 795 Main Street (3-0).
Postponed Paku Paku, Inc., 215 Chandler Street, entertainment license request, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Postponed Italian American World War Veterans of the US Inc. Post 3, 14 Itam Court, change of manager request, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Approved lodging house license for PSI Theta Nu Fraternity, 8 Elbridge Street (3-0).
Postponed Italian American World War Vets of The US, 14 Itam Court, failure to file amendment paperwork status hearing, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Filed the status item for Chen Ye Worcester Inc dba BBQ Chicken, 102 Shrewsbury Street (3-0).
Continued Hidden Gem Hospitality LLC, 97-101 Water Street, to the first meeting in December (3-0).
Postponed Seabra Restaurant, 333 Pleasant Street, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Postponed The Broadway, 100 Water Street, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Filed SMG/DCU, 50 Foster Street (3-0).
Postponed JMAC, 20 Franklin Street, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Postponed Hinoelia Rivera dba El Coqui Liquor, 184 Chandler Street, to September 24, 2026 (3-0).
Filed Aelux Lounge communication dated August 21, 2026, which reported the business has closed.
Filed Mexicali Cantina, 225 Shrewsbury Street, notice of manager’s resignation.

License Commission 
         Meeting Minutes 
   SEPTEMBER 10, 2026 
 
 
Attendance: 
 
Commissioners 
Present: 
 
 
Anthony Vigliotti, Chair 
Charran Fisher, Commissioner 
Maritza Cruz, Commissioner 
 
Commissioners 
Absent: 
 
Staff Present: 
 
 
 
Sgt. Thomas Needham, Worcester Police Department  
Amanda Moran, Law Department 
Deborah Steele, Licensing  
 
 
 
            
Minutes: August 20, 2026 
 
Upon a roll call the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the minutes of August 20, 2026. 
 
Requests for Continuances, Extensions, Postponements, & Withdrawals 
 
One Day Liquor & Entertainment Requests 
 
 
 
1. Our Lady of Mercy Maronite Catholic Church, 341 June Street 
Request for one day liquor license 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music, live show, DJ’s 
• Saturday-September 26, 2026-Noon-11:00 p.m. 
• Sunday-September 27, 2026-11:30 a.m.-6:00 p.m. 
 
Father Peter Frangie, participating remotely, stated that is for their annual festival. He stated that 
they expected about 900 people throughout the event and would hire police details.
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day liquor and one-day 
entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits: 
 
Exhibit A:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated August 13, 2026. 
Exhibit B: Application for one day entertainment license received and dated August 13, 2026. 
 
2. Canal Diggers, Inc., 19 Temple Street 
Request for one day liquor license 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music, amplification system 
• Saturday-September 12, 2026-10:30 a.m.-2:00 p.m.  
 
Brenda Moran, participating remotely, stated that this is for the annual Canal Diggers Race and will 
be same set up as previous years and will have police details as well as security. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day liquor and one day-
entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits: 
 
Exhibit A:  Application for one-day liquor license received and dated August 11, 2026. 
Exhibit B: Application for one-day entertainment license received and dated August 11, 2026. 
 
3. Worcester Public Library Foundation, 3 Salem Square 
Request for one day liquor license 
• Thursday-September 17, 2026-6:00 p.m.-7:30 p.m. 
 
Christine Murray, participating remotely, stated that they are looking to have social event at library 
and only expected 80-100 people and will have security present at the event. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day liquor license. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated August 19, 2026. 
 
4. Marc Guinette, 236 Franklin Street 
Request for one day liquor license 
Request for one day entertainment license for dancing by patrons, amplification 
system, light show, dj 
• Friday-September 18, 2026-5:00 p.m.-1:00 a.m. 
 
Larry Boyd appeared upon appeared upon behalf of the applications. He stated that they will be 
hosting the after party for Pride event  which they have done in the past and will have security.
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted to approve the one-day liquor and one-day 
entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits: 
 
Exhibit A:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated August 17, 2026. 
Exhibit B: Application for one day entertainment license received and dated August 17, 2026. 
 
5. Worcester Cycle Bar X 1855, 48 Green Street 
Request for one day entertainment license for DJ’s, amplification systems 
• September 12, 2026-10:30 a.m.-11:30 p.m. rain date – September 19, 2026 
 
Cam Brigham, participating remotely, stated that he will be moving the event to the rain date of  
September 19, 2026, so it does not coincide with the Canal Diggers run. He stated that there will be 
no alcohol at the event and event should end by 2:00 p.m. Chair Vigliotti stated that they will amend 
time to 2:30 p.m. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one-day entertainment license received and dated August 17, 2026. 
 
6. Khalid Karachi, 100 Institute Road 
Request for one day liquor license 
• Saturday-September 26, 2026-11:00 a.m.-3:00 p.m. 
 
Khalid Karachi, participating remotely, stated that this is for a one-day liquor license and they will 
have WPI security at event and the bartenders are liquor trained certificated. He stated that they 
expect about 300 people, but not all will drink. 
 
Upon a roll vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day liquor license. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated August 25, 2026. 
 
7. Ryan Majors, 85 Green Street 
Request for one day liquor license 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music, amplification system 
• Saturday-September 19, 2026-4:00 p.m.-10:00 p.m.  
 
Ryan Majors, participating remotely, stated that this will be for an Octoberfest event and they are 
looking to sell some alcohol and food outside and expect between 200-250 people. They will have a 
police detail and the street will already be closed down for the Woo Sox game and stated that there 
are 7 restrooms in the building. 
 
List of Exhibits:
Exhibit A: Application for one-day liquor license received and dated August 24, 2026. 
Exhibit B: Application for one-day entertainment license received and dated August 24, 2026. 
 
8. Woo Fest Block Party, City View Worcester 
Request for entertainment license for DJ 
• Saturday-September 19, 2026-3:30 p.m.-5:30 p.m. 
 
Dr. King, participating remotely, stated that this is the second year doing and they will have porta 
potties at event. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one day entertainment license received and dated August 17, 2026. 
  
9. Christpher Besaw, 30 Exchange Street 
Request for one  day liquor license 
• Saturday-September 12, 2026-6:00 p.m.-11:00 p.m. 
• Friday-October 2, 2026-5:00 p.m.-11:00 p.m. 
• Saturday-October 10, 2026-Noon-11:00 p.m. 
• Friday-October 16, 2026-4:00 p.m.-11:00 p.m. 
• Saturday-October 31, 2026-Noon-11:00 p.m. 
 
Christopher Besaw, participating remotely, stated that this is request for extension of the dates for 
their concerts, but these will be smaller events, but they will have security present as usual. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day liquor licenses. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one-day liquor license received and dated September 1, 2026.

Alcohol/Entertainment Requests 
15. Falguni Corp, 108 Canterbury Street 
• Request for change of manager 
 
Attorney Matt Porter, participating remotely, stated that they are looking to do a change of manager 
for the location. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the change of manager. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for change of manager received and dated August 17, 2026. 
 
16. Nachos Dining, Inc. dba Mexicali Cantina & Grill, 225 Shrewsbury Street 
• Request  for change of manager 
 
Lissette Rodriguez, participating online, and Adrian Taveras appeared in person appeared on behalf 
of the item.  Ms. Rodriguez stated that they were looking to change the manager to him.   
 
Sgt Neeham stated that there was nothing in background that would preclude him from becoming 
manager but expressed concerns about a recent posting regarding a promoted event and the rules 
were not followed regarding notifying the WPD and License Commission even though Mr. Taveras 
was provided a copy of the rules and WPD/Fire reviewed the rules when the location received a 
nightclub designation. 
 
Sgt. Needham reviewed the rules and what is required when a location receives a nightclub 
designation with the applicant. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the change of manager. 
 
List of Exhibits: Application received and dated August 17, 2026. 
 
17. OM Harsh Corp dba A&B Liquors, 110 McKeon Road 
• Request for change of officers/directors/stock interest
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to postpone the item to the September 24, 2026, 
License Commission meeting. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for change of officers/directors/stock interest received and dated August 
25, 2026. 
 
18. Dubai Restaurant & Lounge, Inc. dba Mexi Town Bar & Grill, 105 Water Street 
• Request for change of manager 
• Request for change of dba to Casa Blanca Restaurant and Lounge 
 
Attorney Felici participating remotely, along with Dargely Mueces Rodriguez and David Bramilia who 
appeared in person appeared on behalf of the item. Attorney Felici stated that they were requesting 
to do a change of manager at the location. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the change of manager. 
 
List of Exhibits: Application for change of manager received and dated August 25, 2026. 
 
19. Interstate Management Company, LLC (dba Hampton Inn & Suites), 65 Prescott Street 
• Request for change of officers/directors 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to postpone the item to the September 24, 2026, 
License Commission meeting. 
 
 
20. Worcester Vice, LLC, 27 Pleasant Street 
• Request for general on premises all alcohol license 
• Request for entertainment license for jukebox, tv, radio, dancing by patrons, 
dancing by entertainers, recorded music, live music, amplification system, play, 
light show, theatrical exhibition, karaoke, DJ-Inside 
• Outside-radio, recorded music, amplification system 
 
Andrew Lapin appeared upon behalf of the application.  Chair Vigliotti stated that the Commission 
members had viewed the site prior to the meeting. 
 
Mr. Lapin stated that he is looking to open a new venue at the location.  
 
Chair Vigliotti stated that only issue that they had at view was the amplification outside which would 
need to be shut off at midnight.  
 
Patrick DiGregoriom, participating remotely, asked what side of the building the amplified music 
would be played. Mr. Lapin stated that at the back of the building.
21. Moss Ventures, LLC dba August Coffee, 548 Main Street 
• Request for restaurant all alcohol license 
 
Allsion Moss, participating remotely, and Madison Martin, who appeared in person, stated that they 
were looking to receive a liquor license as they have been requested by people in the area and they 
are looking to arrange for more storage at location and all staff will be TIPS certified. 
 
Chair Vigliotti stated the Commissioners view the site prior to the meeting. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the restaurant all alcohol license. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for restaurant all alcohol license received and dated August 15, 2026. 
 
22. Metro Convenience Inc. 27 Shrewsbury Street 
• Request for package store malt & wine license  
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to postpone the item to the September 24, 2026, 
License Commission meeting. 
 
 
23. 237 Cambridge LLC dba Shell, 237 Cambridge Street 
• Request for package store malt & wine license 
 
Chair Vigliotti stated that the Commissioners had viewed the site prior to the meeting. 
 
Attorney Kevin Quinlan and Shruibiten Patel appeared upon behalf of the application.  Mr. Quinlan 
stated that the applicant is looking to apply for a package store malt & wine license. He stated that 
the policy of the store that no more than 4 customers will be allowed in store at a time. All 
employees will be TIPS certified. Attorney Quinlan reviewed the Ballarin factors with regard to the 
location. 
 
There was no public comment. 
 
Chair Vigliotti stated that the Commission members are satisfied with the presentation of the 
Ballarin factors and what they saw at the site view. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the package store malt & wine license. 
 
List of Exhibits: Application for package store malt & wine license received and dated August 27, 
2026. 
 
24. Punta Cana Bar & Grill Restaurant, Inc., 795 Main Street 
Request for change of manager
Request for change of officers/directors

they looking to do change of officers and change of manager as the old manager has resigned. 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the change of officers/directors and 
change of manager. 
List of Exhibits: Application for change of officers/directors and change of manager received and

29. Chen Ye Worcester Inc dba BBQ Chicken, 102 Shrewsbury Street
Attorney Chung Le and Tong Chen appeared upon behalf of the item. Attorney Le stated that 
they are sorry for delay but they have been working with the building department as they have 
specialized equipment that they were putting in and they are working with the building

Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to adjourn the meeting at 11:16 a.m.
